name: 83 Sciences
long_description: 83 Sciences helps labs unlock value from the experiments that never make it to publication (“hidden data”). We show up in-person, meet with the researchers, and structure the data into a queryable database. Then we put this data to work, helping scientists learn from their lab's full history, including all of the “failed” experiments, to uncover novel materials.
one_liner: Materials discovery, driven by your full experimental record, not…
